name: Photato
subtitle: Native image editing for Mac
promotionalText: If you know your way around a professional image editor, Photato will feel familiar. Completely free, native to Mac, and still in early alpha.
description:
Photato is a completely free image editor for Mac, written in native Swift. If you know your way around a professional image editor, Photato will feel familiar. Build layered compositions, paint, adjust colour and experiment with masks in a familiar desktop workspace.

EARLY ALPHA
Photato is still under active development. Many planned functions are unavailable, and rendering and file compatibility are still being tested. It is not yet a replacement for a finished professional editor. Keep your originals and work on copies.

EXPLORE THE EDITOR
• Compose with layers, groups, masks and selections.
• Paint, retouch and adjust colour with native controls.
• Work with text, shapes, fills and document guides.
• Keep selections for later with Quick Mask and saved channels.
• Save native Photato projects and explore supported PSD, PSB and image workflows. Compatibility is incomplete.
• Automate supported editing operations through an optional authenticated local API.

YOUR MAC, YOUR WORKSPACE
Ordinary editing runs on your Mac and does not require an account or an AI service. Photato targets macOS 14 or later, with native Apple Silicon and Intel builds. Qualification across supported systems is ongoing.

OPTIONAL APPLE AI
Eligible Apple Silicon Macs with macOS 26 or later can use available Apple Intelligence features. Availability depends on your device, language, region, system settings and downloaded models. Supported Apple image services may use Private Cloud Compute and an internet connection. AI is optional.

BUILT WITH AI-AIDED DEVELOPMENT
Photato demonstrates what AI-aided software development can produce. The developer diary records implementation work, tests, failures and remaining gaps. This alpha is an invitation to follow that progress, not a claim of complete professional-editor parity.

COMPLETELY FREE
No purchases, subscriptions, tips or paid feature unlocks. The source repository will become public on the same day the software is released.

Photato is an independent project with roots in PhotoCraft by the ArtCraft Team and contributors. It retains upstream attribution under MIT OR Apache-2.0. Photato is not affiliated with Adobe or endorsed by the upstream PhotoCraft project.
